clips.title: The story
paras: Atop the Stonewrought Dam, Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII keeps watch over its workings and defenses. The veteran dwarf maintains its great structure and machinery as grave dangers threaten the dam.

Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII tends the Stonewrought Dam, where dwarven stonecraft holds back the waters of the Loch. Along its crest, he watches the waterways and sluice gates, and checks the structure for strain from the elements and local hazards. Its workings demand constant care.
